question: Let \(A,B,C\) be three points on a straight line, \(B\) lying between \(A\) and \(C\). Consider all circles passing through \(B\) and \(C\). The points of contact of the tangents from \(A\) to these circles lie on

options.D: a curve of none of the foregoing types
